newsitem.title: USA: US/China trade flow disappointing-Commerce's Daley.
newsitem.headline: US/China trade flow disappointing-Commerce's Daley.

text.p: The U.S. trade balance with China is "disappointing," Secretary of Commerce William Daley said Thursday.

"Our trade flows with China continue to be disappointing," Daley said in a statement. "Our exports are four percent below last year's rate for the first four months, while our imports are up 27 percent."

He added that U.S. exports to China are failing to keep up with the pace of imports and complained that China's market was too closed for U.S. exports, adding that "We must make every effort to open that market to U.S. goods and services."
Earlier Friday, the Commerce Department in its report on world trade for April, said the U.S. deficit with China jumped 33.3 percent to $3.45 billion, up from $2.59 billion in March.
